items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Jerome Pasquall was considered one of the top saxophone players. Because the Pittsburgh Courier and the Chicago Defender would show you pictures of these guys, and you'd see who was great, and had a name.

ctx.x: Jerome Pasquall was one of the masters. He had been with Fletcher, he had been with King Oliver, he had been with that big...that great...Cooke's band... Charlie Cooke.
